nativeBefore.case: startup reconciliation expires stale state and prunes only closed recordings
nativeBefore.error: central_invalid_response: Central support service returned an invalid session authority.

cause: fakeCentral sampled activation and expiry from separate wall-clock reads. If the clock ticked, expiresAt exceeded activatedAt + durationHours, correctly rejected by support authority validation.
repair: Derive expiry from the single activation timestamp and supply the manager test clock to its fake central service. Keep production duration validation and assertions intact.
